- GDPR / HIPAA: clarification on data processing roles and whether we can sign a BAA for private deployments.

2) Marissa Cole (cc) — provide SOC 2 report, IR playbook summary, and BCP/DR evidence (table-top exercise date and runbooks). Target: 2026-06-08.
3) Laura Bennett (cc) — review any contractual language re: breach notification SLA / BAA and flag anything procurement might push back on. Target: 2026-06-09.

Attachments we plan to include: SOC2_Report_2024-11.pdf (redacted), Incident_Response_Playbook_v2.docx (summary), BCP_DR_Summary.pdf (high-level).

Thanks — will follow up with Marissa and Laura to get the artifacts over.

Jordan — thanks for the recap and nice to meet you today. A couple clarifications and immediate asks from procurement/security: 

1) Questionnaire: here’s the link to our vendor questionnaire — it covers incident response timelines, encryption, data residency, and subprocessor lists. https://fintechcorp.typeform.com/to/security-questionnaire

2) SOC 2: we prefer a SOC 2 Type II within the last 12 months. If you have a Type II report, please include it; if not, please provide the latest Type I and the roadmap to Type II.

3) Breach notification / IR timelines: we typically require a commitment to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a security incident that impacts customer data. Can Redwood confirm your policy/timeline and the point of contact for incident escalation?

4) BCP/DR evidence: procurement would like a short artifact showing recovery RTO/RPO targets and date of last DR tabletop exercise. If you can attach a one-page summary that’s acceptable for review.

Procurement is hoping to get initial artifacts by EOD 2026-06-09 to keep the purchase order on track. If anything will slip, let us know ASAP.

Thanks — Sam

Jordan / team — thanks for the ping. Below are the items I can share immediately and the planned follow-ups. I’m attaching the artifacts referenced.

SOC 2:
- We completed a SOC 2 Type II examination covering our production infrastructure and control environment in Nov 2024. Report: SOC2_Report_2024-11.pdf (attached). If you need additional evidence we can provide the auditor letter and management response under NDA.

Incident Response & Breach Notification:
- Detection & confirmation: internal detection and triage timelines vary by incident type; we aim to identify and confirm security incidents within 24–48 hours depending on signals.
- Customer notification: our policy is to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirmation of an incident involving customer data, where feasible and permitted by law. We will provide point-of-contact details and escalation matrix as part of the IR summary.
- Artifacts attached: Incident_Response_Playbook_v2.docx (redacted playbook summary).

BCP/DR:
- RTO/RPO: standard production tier RTO = 4 hours, RPO = 15 minutes for stateful critical services; non-critical services have longer windows (details in attached summary).
- Last tabletop exercise: 2026-04-15 (internal, cross-functional). Evidence summarized in BCP_DR_Summary.pdf (attached).

Regulatory:
- GDPR: we publish a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and support standard contractual clauses where required.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads on our Private deployment offering; we sign BAAs for Private deployments and recommend customers use dedicated capacity for PHI.

Questionnaire next steps:
- I pulled the Typeform link and will work with Jordan to populate the high-priority fields first (incident response timelines, encryption at rest/in transit, access control, subprocessor list).
- For anything that requires legal approval (contractual commitments), I’ve looped in Laura.

Links / evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-security-evidence (restricted — shareable link will be set for FinTechCorp once NDA/LOI is in place).

I’ve attached the following: SOC2_Report_2024-11.pdf (pdf, redacted), Incident_Response_Playbook_v2.docx (docx, redacted), BCP_DR_Summary.pdf (pdf). If procurement needs stronger SLAs or different contractual language for breach notification, Laura — please advise.
